rss: Inflation is heating up but don't expect another crisis
title: Rising Prices for Fizz and Candy
story: Prices for Fizz soda and candy are going up because things used to make them are costing more. People might need to save more coins to buy their favorite treats.
storyBig: The cost of producing Fizz soda and CNDY candy is rising due to increased ingredient expenses, leading to higher retail prices. This inflationary pressure may affect consumer purchasing decisions and market demand.
think: Why do you think prices go up when ingredients cost more?
bull: Fizz and Candy are still popular despite higher prices.
bear: People may buy less Fizz and Candy if prices keep rising.

rss: Mobile payments on the rise but cash decline slows
title: More Kids Using Phone Payments
story: More kids are using phones to pay for things instead of cash, making shopping faster. But, some still like using coins and bills for their purchases.
storyBig: The trend towards mobile payments is accelerating as more consumers, including young ones, prefer digital transactions over cash. Despite this, the decline in cash usage is slowing as some consumers still appreciate tangible currency.
think: Why might some people still like using cash?
bull: Using phones to pay is quick and easy!
bear: Not everyone has a phone for making payments yet.
